visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a purple pot on an induction stovetop. A person's hand enters the frame and sprinkles white salt into the boiling water. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from a nearby window. The background features light-colored wooden cabinets. (2) A large bunch of fresh green spinach is carefully placed into the boiling water. The person uses a metal slotted spoon to push the leaves down, ensuring they are fully submerged. The steam rises from the pot, indicating high heat. (3) After blanching, the spinach is lifted out with the slotted spoon and immediately plunged into a stainless steel bowl filled with ice and water. This cooling process is shown in a close-up to highlight the vibrant green color of the vegetable. (4) The person takes the chilled spinach out and uses both hands to firmly squeeze out the excess water. The spinach is then placed into a wire mesh strainer for further drainage. (5) On a light-colored wooden cutting board, the squeezed spinach is aligned and sliced into uniform segments with a large chef's knife. The camera captures the precise movements of the hands and the sharp blade. (6) The chopped spinach is transferred into a blue and white patterned ceramic bowl. A dark liquid, likely soy sauce, is poured from a glass bottle, followed by a lighter liquid, presumably sesame oil. (7) Using a pair of dark-colored chopsticks, the person thoroughly tosses the spinach with the seasonings. A small wooden spoon is then used to sprinkle toasted sesame seeds over the top. The final dish is presented on a small white plate with blue polka dots, placed on a wooden tray.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 煮一鍋水，水裡加入鹽. (2) [Subtitle]: 水滾之後，放入菠菜 (菠菜請先洗乾淨！). (3) [Subtitle]: 整株放入鍋裡汆燙 不凌亂... (4) [Subtitle]: 大約汆燙10秒左右，直到菠菜梗變軟即可. (5) [Subtitle]: 立刻放入冰水裡面降溫. (6) [Subtitle]: 降溫後，取出來 用手擠出水分... (7) [Subtitle]: 先放到濾網上 等等再擠乾一次！. (8) [Subtitle]: 將蒂去除. (9) [Subtitle]: 每一段切成等長. (10) [Subtitle]: 一點醬油、白芝麻油 喜歡蒜味可以加一點蒜泥... (11) [Subtitle]: 拌一拌... (12) [Subtitle]: 最後一點白芝麻粒. (13) [Slogan]: 超級簡單的『涼拌菠菜』就完成啦～～❤️❤️. (14) [Slogan]: 趁菠菜季節的時候趕快來試試～❤️❤️. (15) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, mid-tempo acoustic guitar BGM featuring a male vocal singing in English. Simultaneously, a rhythmic bubbling sound of boiling water is heard. (2) A clear splashing sound occurs as the spinach hits the water, followed by the metallic resonance of a slotted spoon tapping the pot. The BGM maintains a steady, cheerful pace. (3) A sequence of sharp, cold clinking sounds represents ice hitting the bowl and water swirling. The male vocal continues with a relaxed, melodic tone. (4) Wet squeezing sounds are layered over the music, indicating the removal of excess moisture from the spinach. (5) A series of crisp, rhythmic thuds occur as the knife slices through the vegetable onto the wooden board. The BGM remains dominant but shares the mix with these percussive foley sounds. (6) A soft 'glug' and liquid pouring sound are audible as the seasonings are added. (7) Rhythmic clicking and scraping of wooden chopsticks against a ceramic bowl are heard during the mixing phase. (8) The video concludes with a light 'thump' as the plate is set on the tray, and the BGM fades out with a final melodic guitar strum.
